stage: Diagnostic of saved failed pilot, never a replacement efficacy verdict.
question: Does the context head rank supported required class interventions above keep cases even though its fixed deployment probability margin made almost no changes?
data: Exactly candidate12 fitting/head-held-out cached frames, diagnostic-ignore filtered; conflict rows with original score>=0.25 only.
positive: Saved geometric-owned target differs from original class; this is an intervention proxy, not proof of detection-level net gain.
score: Best supported alternative class softmax probability minus original class probability. No action execution, new thresholds, fitting or probability calibration.
metrics: Confidence-weighted AUROC and unweighted AUROC, positive/negative counts, target-class rank among alternatives. Report fitting and holdout separately.
interpretation: A pass only justifies investigation of a new explicitly registered objective/calibration hypothesis. Candidate12 STOP remains. If only ordinary evidence has a signal, do not credit observation context or treat it as new.
budget: Read saved feature files and run two tiny CPU heads; no detector forward, image decoding, training, calibration, policy execution or official evaluation.
limits: AUROC on geometric supervision is not AP/AR or reliable correction precision; all scenes and models already viewed. No independent confirmation or novelty claim.
